_readme: S739 (lever), the gap census's reader_page_assignment lever (census of 2026-11-26 01:19Z): 5 programs of Coastline Community College whose filed record places none of the state's listed courses and for which the 2026-27 catalog prints no page of their own. Free read 45774426242 loaded the catalog's 252 listed pages again (no model call); its capture preview is the source of each note. These are filed as named gaps and are never sent to a paid read. Their filed records stay as filed (the load skips a record that places none). No Supabase write. They are the college's to settle in COCI. Not a named gap: Communications Studies 2.0 A.A.-T. 43057 has its own page (communication-studies-2-aat/, 9 of its 9 listed courses), which the reader hands to the legacy Communication Studies A.A.-T. 33014 because the page prints 'Communication Studies 2.0' where the state's title reads 'Communications Studies 2.0'; it waits on a reader change. Introduction to Careers in Esports 40476 is read from its own page (paid read with only=).

reasons.credit_not_in_catalog: A credit program the 2026-27 catalog prints under no page of its own: no page the capture read names its title with its award, and its pathway's page lists no such award.
